title: PlayOS Game Manifest v1
description: Stable metadata contract for a game installed under /data/games/<game-id>/manifest.json. Unknown fields are ignored; only missing required fields or invalid values are rejected.

id.description: Reverse-DNS game identifier; must equal the parent directory name.

name.description: Human-readable display name shown in the shell library.

executable.description: Path to the launchable binary, relative to the game directory.

api_version.description: PlayOS platform API version this game was built against; must be <= the running system's PLAYOS_API_VERSION.

architecture.description: Target CPU architecture (e.g. x86_64, aarch64); must match the running system.

controllers.description: Whether the game requires a controller.

network.description: Whether the game requires network access.

description.description: Short description shown in the shell game detail screen.

icon.description: Path to a PNG icon, relative to the game directory (e.g. assets/icon.png).
